thread:
Lina M.: Heads-up: users are pasting 'Model display name' into the API field and getting 404s. Noted in support.

Owen R.: That's because API expects `model_id`. We should make the console map clearer.

Tess H.: Suggestion: Add microcopy under the input: "API identifier: `model_id` — used in CLI/API calls" and a tiny 'Learn more' link to docs. Ensure link text is descriptive for screen readers.

Lina M.: Good. Also add a 1-row mapping in the in-product docs panel: UI label -> API field. Keep it scannable.

infra-bot: Docs PR opened by @owen: https://gh.internal/redwood/docs/pull/512 00adds anchor /docs/console/models#id-map and a short mapping table.

Owen R.: Frontend note: don't rename backend props now. We'll ship helper + aria-describedby. Estimate 2 dev-hours + review.

Tess H.: I'll draft copy and run the a11y checks (contrast, aria-describedby, link text).

Lina M.: Plan: ship helper + docs link this sprint; monitor support for two weeks, then decide on label rename if needed. Owners: Tess (copy/a11y), Owen (FE), Docs (anchor).
